headline: X rolls out its first-ever parental control features
summary: X is rolling out its first parental controls, letting parents and guardians see how much time their child spends on the platform, set daily limits, and require approval for new followers, while teens keep ownership of their accounts. Outlets note X and Twitter had never offered real parental controls before.
